items.title: 股價較高點回跌逾4成！SpaceX首份財報將掀牌 AI、星鏈、星艦受檢驗
items.title_en: Stock Falls Over 40% From Recent Highs! SpaceX's First Earnings Report to Spotlight AI, Starlink, Starship Scrutiny
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US)將於美東時間周二(4日)盤後公布2026會計年度第2季財報，市場預料結果可能引發股價劇烈波動，目前以人工智慧(AI)業務營收、虧損與資本支出這三大數字最受關注。
這家由全球首富馬斯克領軍的公司，目前市值約1.4兆美元，數周前一度高達3兆美元，目前股價仍為2026年預估營收的35倍，使本次財報成為市場焦點。
Cantor Fitzgerald分析師Colin Canfield表示，目前市場預估值分歧極大，「幾乎沒有人真正知道會開出什麼數字」，財報結果可能與市場預期出現相當大的落差。
AI財務數字與展望
SpaceX目前將業務劃分為三大部門，包括：太空(火箭發射與星艦計畫)，連網(星鏈衛星網路)，AI(主要為今年2月併入的xAI業務)。
三者當中，以AI業務最受市場關注，其在2026年第1季營收為8.18億美元，但營業虧損高達25億美元，單季資本支出更達77億美元。
市場將聚焦三項關鍵指標：AI營收是否快速成長，虧損是否收斂，
AI資本支出是否持續擴大。
SpaceX已與Anthropic及Google(GOOGL-US)簽署AI資料中心租賃協議。兩者當中，Google合約尚未開始貢獻營收，Anthropic每月約12.5億美元的租賃合約，則於5、6月逐步放量，但實際認列營收及獲利率仍不明朗。
投資人也將關注SpaceX對今年下半年及2027年AI業務展望，以及利用星鑑部署低成本AI運算衛星的測試時程。
星艦進度、星鏈用戶
星鑑(Starship)於7月完成第13次飛行測試，市場將關注：第14次測試何時進行，以及星鑑的研發支出規模。
SpaceX在第1季的太空事業新增廠房與設備支出約11億美元。
太空部門2025年營收41億美元，營業虧損為6.57億美元。而獵鷹九號(Falcon 9)在第2季的火箭發射約36次，多數為星鏈(Starlink)任務，因此不會認列為太空部門收入，市場預料投資人仍將把焦點放在AI及星鏈，而非火箭發射業務。
星鏈方面，截至第1季季末的全球訂戶已達1030萬戶，較一年前約500萬戶倍增。該項業務在2025年的營收為114億美元，營業利益44億美元。
市場將關注星鏈的訂戶成長速度、每位用戶平均收入(ARPU)，以及
企業及政府客戶訂單。Canfield預期，SpaceX將首度揭露更多有關星鏈的營運指標。
Canfield預期，這份財報將優於市場預期，且全年獲利展望可望上修。
目前華爾街平均預估第2季營收將為69億美元，而稅息折舊及攤銷前利益(EBITDA)為21億美元
全年部分，營收估為390億美元，EBITDA為173億美元。不過市場預估分歧極大。
解禁賣壓仍是股價隱憂
SapceX周一盤中一度跌至每股104.83美元、創上市新低，但終場反彈5.68%，收在每股114.53美元。然而周一收盤價仍比6月16日首次公開發行(IPO)後創下的歷史收盤高點(201.80美元)回跌了43%。
其中一項憂慮來自IPO禁售期即將屆滿。根據規劃，8月6日將有約9.12億股解禁，約一周後另有3.19億股解禁。
市場擔心早期投資人可能趁機獲利了結，對股價形成賣壓。但也有分析認為，市場通常會提前反映已知消息，因此真正解禁後未必再出現新一波拋售。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) will release its fiscal 2026 Q2 earnings after market close on Tuesday (the 4th) Eastern Time. The market expects the results could trigger sharp stock volatility, with AI revenue, losses, and capital expenditures being the three most watched figures.

Led by the world’s richest man Elon Musk, the company now has a market value of about $1.4 trillion, after briefly reaching $3 trillion a few weeks ago. Its share price still trades at roughly 35 times the projected 2026 revenue, making this earnings release a focal point for investors.

Cantor Fitzgerald analyst Colin Canfield said market valuation estimates are wildly divergent, "almost nobody really knows what numbers will be reported," and the earnings could differ substantially from expectations.
AI Financial Numbers and Outlook

SpaceX currently groups its operations into three divisions: Space (rocket launches and the Starship program), Connectivity (the Starlink satellite network), and AI (mainly the xAI business that was folded in February this year).

Among them, the AI segment draws the most market attention. It posted Q1 2026 revenue of $818 million but an operating loss of $2.5 billion, and capital expenditures for the quarter reached $7.7 billion.
The market will focus on three key AI metrics: whether AI revenue is growing quickly, whether losses are narrowing, and whether AI capex continues to expand.

SpaceX has signed AI data‑center leasing agreements with Anthropic and Google (GOOGL-US). Google’s contract has not yet contributed revenue, while Anthropic’s lease is about $1.25 billion per month and is expected to ramp up in May and June, though actual recognized revenue and profit margins remain unclear.
Investors will also watch SpaceX’s outlook for AI in the second half of this year and in 2027, as well as the schedule for testing low‑cost AI‑computing satellites deployed via Starship.
Starship Progress and Starlink Users
Starship completed its 13th flight test in July. The market will watch when the 14th test will occur and the scale of R&D spending for Starship.
SpaceX’s Space division recorded roughly $1.1 billion in new plant and equipment spending in Q1.

The Space segment generated $4.1 billion in revenue for 2025 and an operating loss of $657 million. Falcon 9 performed about 36 launches in Q2, most of which were Starlink missions and therefore not counted as Space‑division revenue. Investors are expected to keep their focus on AI and Starlink rather than on launch activity.

For Starlink, global subscriber numbers reached 10.3 million by the end of Q1, roughly double the 5 million a year earlier. The business posted $11.4 billion in revenue and $4.4 billion in operating profit in 2025.

The market will monitor Starlink’s subscriber growth rate, average revenue per user (ARPU), and enterprise and government contracts. Canfield expects SpaceX to disclose more operational metrics for Starlink for the first time.
Canfield anticipates the earnings will beat market expectations and that the full‑year profit outlook could be revised upward.

Wall Street currently forecasts Q2 revenue of $6.9 billion and EBITDA of $2.1 billion. For the full year, revenue is projected at $39 billion with EBITDA of $17.3 billion, though estimates vary widely among analysts.
Unlocking‑related Selling Pressure Remains a Stock Risk

SpaceX’s shares fell intraday on Monday to $104.83, a new low since the company went public, but recovered 5.68% to close at $114.53. Even so, Monday’s close was still 43% below the post‑IPO historical high of $201.80 set on June 16.
One concern stems from the upcoming end of the IPO lock‑up period. About 912 million shares are slated to unlock on August 6, with another 319 million shares scheduled to unlock roughly a week later.

The market worries early investors may seize the chance to cash out, creating selling pressure on the stock. Some analysts, however, argue that markets usually price in known events ahead of time, so a post‑unlock wave of selling may not materialize.

items.title: 信邦7月營收連4個月改寫新高 今年無人機業務估倍數成長
items.title_en: XINBANG's July Revenue Sets New High for Four Consecutive Months; Drone Business Expected to Grow Multiple Times This Year
paras: 連接線大廠信邦(3023-TW)今(4)日公告7月營收31.67億元，連續4個月創公司成立以來單月營收歷史新高，月增2.41%、年增近29%；累計前7月營收205.54億元，創同期新高，年增11.44%。
針對市場關注的無人機布局，信邦表示，公司聚焦具高法規門檻與營運壁壘的「商用運輸」市場，避開競爭激烈的消費型空拍應用，隨著美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)正式核准相關營運與製造，該市場已由先前的驗證階段，逐步進入實際商業化營運。
信邦看好，今年無人機相關業務將較去年呈現倍數成長，在法規紅利與商用需求逐步釋放下，未來兩年將持續維持強勁的成長動能，成為公司下一波營運成長的新引擎。
針對7月營收表現，信邦說明，主要受惠於醫療、汽車及工業應用等領域銷售增溫，分別較6月增長14.80%、16.04%及4.05%。MAGIC 五大產業累計前7月表現相較去年同期，醫療及健康照護產業成長26.28%、汽車產業成長25.40%、綠能產業減少8.09%、工業應用產業成長30.51%、通訊及電子週邊產業減少9.41%。
營收比重方面，工業應用產業佔36.10%；通訊及電子週邊產業佔19.47%；綠能產業佔17.90%；汽車產業佔16.78%；醫療及健康照護產業佔9.75%；以產品別區分，連接線組生產銷售佔77.85%；連接器及零組件銷售佔22.15%。
paras_en: Cable manufacturer XINBANG (3023‑TW) announced today (4th) that July revenue reached NT$31.67 billion, marking the fourth consecutive month since the company's founding to hit a record‑high monthly revenue. The figure represents a month‑over‑month increase of 2.41% and a year‑over‑year rise of nearly 29%. Cumulative revenue for the first seven months of the year totaled NT$205.54 billion, also a new peak for the same period, up 11.44% year‑on‑year.

Regarding market interest in its drone initiatives, XINBANG said it is focusing on the "commercial transport" segment, which has high regulatory thresholds and operational barriers, and deliberately avoiding the fiercely competitive consumer‑drone market. With the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) now formally approving related operations and manufacturing, the market has moved from a validation stage to gradual commercial deployment.

XINBANG is optimistic that its drone‑related business will grow multiple times compared with last year. Benefiting from regulatory incentives and the gradual release of commercial demand, the company expects strong growth momentum to continue over the next two years, positioning drones as the next engine for operational expansion.

On the July revenue performance, XINBANG explained that the increase was mainly driven by higher sales in medical, automotive and industrial applications, which rose 14.80%, 16.04% and 4.05% respectively versus June. Across its five core segments, year‑to‑date performance versus the same period last year showed medical and health‑care up 26.28%, automotive up 25.40%, green energy down 8.09%, industrial applications up 30.51% and communications/electronics peripherals down 9.41%.

In terms of revenue composition, industrial applications accounted for 36.10%; communications and electronics peripherals 19.47%; green energy 17.90%; automotive 16.78%; and medical and health‑care 9.75%. By product type, cable assemblies contributed 77.85% of sales, while connectors and components made up the remaining 22.15%.

items.title: 〈陸股盤後〉午後兩市攜手走高 漲幅擴大 三大指數齊揚
items.title_en: Mainland China Stock Market Closes Higher, Three Major Indices Rise
paras: 中國A股三大指數4日（周二）集體開高，早盤指數分化，滬弱深強，午後兩市攜手走高，漲幅擴大。
滬深兩市成交總額為人民幣2.2136兆元，較前一交易日增加2,162億元。
中金公司研報表示，7月下旬以來指數震盪盤整，8月A股行情可能進入大幅回調後修復階段。結合7月市場快速調整，建議近期開始關注兩條主線：
1）景氣成長仍需要精挑細選：
科技風格劇烈調整之後擁擠度已經有明顯回落，景氣足夠高的產業能夠實現分子端高增長對沖分母端拖累的效果，AI基礎設施相關環節，如PCB等環節，高景氣狀態在今年確定性仍較強，半導體及算力等領域較多公司則仍需要關注基本面與估值的匹配程度，科技成長後市或呈現分化走勢；創新藥較多公司進入臨床數據驗證階段，值得自下而上關注。
2）周期改善：
越來越多領域基本面正從周期底部回升，建議綜合考慮地緣局勢與產能周期位置，關注業績向好及供需格局改善的領域，如電網設備、石化化工、工程機械，以及受益資本市場向好的非銀金融等行業；貴金屬板塊經歷較多調整後也值得關注。純內需行業的基本面回升進展仍然相對偏緩，需要進一步觀察。
8月超配行業：基礎化工、通訊設備、電力電器設備、機械、證券。8月低配行業：建築與工程、紡織服裝、教育、輕工家居、零售。
paras_en: The three major indices of China's A-share market collectively opened higher on Tuesday, with the Shanghai index underperforming the Shenzhen index in the morning session. However, both markets rose together in the afternoon, with the gains expanding.

The Shanghai Composite Index closed 0.33% higher at 3,822.28 points, while the Shenzhen Component Index rose 3.25% to 13,885.71 points. The ChiNext Index, which tracks China's startup board, surged 5.64% to 3,488.97 points.
The total turnover of the two markets reached 2.2136 trillion yuan, an increase of 21.62 billion yuan from the previous trading day.

According to a research report by CICC, the index has been fluctuating and consolidating since late July, and the A-share market may enter a correction and recovery phase in August. Combining the rapid adjustment of the market in July, it is recommended to focus on two main lines in the near term: 1) Selecting industries with strong growth momentum, as the crowdedness of the technology sector has decreased significantly after the drastic adjustment, and industries with high growth can achieve high growth at the molecular end to offset the drag at the denominator end.

2) Cyclical improvement, as more and more fields are recovering from the bottom of the cycle. It is recommended to comprehensively consider the geopolitical situation and the location of the production capacity cycle, and pay attention to fields with improving performance and supply and demand patterns, such as power grid equipment, petrochemicals, engineering machinery, and non-bank financial industries that benefit from the capital market. The precious metals sector is also worth attention after experiencing significant adjustments.

The basic fundamentals of pure domestic demand industries are still recovering at a relatively slow pace and need to be observed further. The industries with high allocation in August are: basic chemicals, communication equipment, electrical equipment, machinery, and securities. The industries with low allocation in August are: construction and engineering, textiles and apparel, education, light industry and home furnishings, and retail.

items.title: 高端腸病毒疫苗首批出口至越南 8月起貢獻營收
items.title_en: High-End Vaccine's First Batch Exported to Vietnam, to Contribute to Revenue Starting August
paras: 高端疫苗(6547-TW)今年上半年取得越南藥品管理局(DAV)核發的新藥上市許可後，目前完成品質檢驗並進行批次放行程序，於今(4)日啟動首批疫苗出口作業，運抵越南，預計8月開始貢獻營收，後續將運送各批次疫苗，今年將持續出貨。
高端疫苗旗下自主研發「恩穩健」腸病毒71型疫苗，於今年3月17日取得越南法規主管機關核准核發的新藥上市許可證，為越南官方核發的首張腸病毒疫苗藥證。
高端疫苗指出，為確保疫苗在跨國運輸過程中，完全符合國際優良運銷規範(GDP)要求，公司選用「主動式溫控集裝箱」，透過精密的數位控溫與獨立供電系統，有效排除長途空運與外在氣候的潛在變數，讓每劑疫苗自台灣廠區至飛抵越南的過程中，皆受到恆溫防護，維持與出廠時一致的品質。
paras_en: High-end vaccine (6547-TW) obtained a new drug license from Vietnam's Drug Administration of Vietnam (DAV) in the first half of this year. After completing quality inspections and batch release procedures, the company initiated its first vaccine export operation today (4th), shipping the vaccines to Vietnam. It is expected to start contributing to revenue in August, with subsequent batches to be shipped continuously throughout the year.

High-end vaccine's self-developed 'EV71 vaccine' obtained a new drug license from Vietnam's regulatory authority on March 17th this year, marking the first enterovirus vaccine license issued by the Vietnamese government.

To ensure the vaccines meet international good distribution practice (GDP) requirements during cross-border transportation, the company uses 'active temperature-controlled containers' with precise digital temperature control and independent power supply systems. This effectively eliminates potential variables from long-distance air transport and external climate, keeping each dose of vaccine at a consistent temperature from the factory in Taiwan to arrival in Vietnam, maintaining the same quality as when it left the factory.

items.title: 百容半導體應用業務需求強 7月營收優於上月創50個月來新高
items.title_en: Bao Rong Semiconductor Sees Strong Demand for Its Application Business, 7M Revenue Surpasses 50-Month High
paras: 百容 (2483-TW)今(4)日公布最新營收資訊， 在半導體客戶端下單且拉貨趨積極之下，推升 7 月營收向上，百容 7 月營收勝 6 月的 1.98 億元達2.01億元，改寫 50 個月 來單月營收新高。
百容2026年 7 月營收2.01億元，月增1.75%，年增37.19%，2026年1-7月營收12.47億元，年增幅達20.24%，百容 7月的營收比重中，半導體應用客戶拉貨力道仍強勁，另因反映銅價上漲， 提升此一業務區塊的營收向上。
百容 2026 年第二季單季營收達 5.66 億元，創同期新高，季增 17.62%，年增 20.42%，同時，在百容第二季在毛利率及營業利益同步走高，加上業外及匯率等有利因素挹注，百容所獲挹注上半年稅後純益將逾 4362 萬元，每股純益達 0.41 元。百容將在 8 月 7 日公布財報獲利數字。
百容在 2026 年第一季財報營收 4.81 億元，毛利率 13.23%，季增 4.33 個百分點，年增 4.84 個百分點，2026 年第一季稅後純益 1604 萬元，較上一季及去年同期都由虧轉盈，每股純益 0.15 元。在第二季自結數字之下，顯示百容在 2026 年第二季維持盈餘的營運，且單季本業、業外獲利表現甚佳之下，單季營收及獲利更進一步超越第一季表現。
值得注意的是，百容在 2026 年第二季營收達 5.66 億元，創同期新高，其中半導體應用占比也達 50.4%，並帶動第二季單季的毛利率及營業淨利率上揚的走勢。
在百容半導體客戶需求高持續追單有利情況之下，公司爲進一步發展此一業務區塊，董事會決議以 3.23 億元購置台中工業區工一路廠房及土地，這也是今年以來繼大立光 (3008-TW) 在台中工業區的提供生產用商用不動產購置案。 百容購置台中工業區工一路廠房及土地，土地面積達 702 坪，預計將另投入資金購買設備及另重新與建廠房容納重型沖壓設備進駐，將開發生產大功率散熱片。
paras_en: Bao Rong (2483-TW) announced its latest revenue information today, with the company's semiconductor client orders and shipments becoming more active, driving 7M revenue up. Bao Rong's 7M revenue of NT$2.01 billion surpassed NT$1.98 billion in June, setting a new high for the company's single-month revenue over the past 50 months.

Bao Rong's 7M revenue was NT$2.01 billion, up 1.75% from the previous month and 37.19% from the same period last year. The company's revenue for the first seven months of 2026 was NT$12.47 billion, with a year-over-year growth rate of 20.24%. In 7M, the revenue of Bao Rong's semiconductor application business remained strong, and the revenue increase was also driven by the rise in copper prices.

Bao Rong's revenue for the second quarter of 2026 was NT$5.66 billion, a new high for the same period. The revenue increased by 17.62% from the previous quarter and 20.42% from the same period last year. At the same time, Bao Rong's gross margin and operating profit both rose in the second quarter, and the company also benefited from favorable factors such as industry and exchange rates. As a result, Bao Rong's net profit for the first half of 2026 is expected to exceed NT$43.62 million, with a net profit per share of NT$0.41.

Bao Rong's revenue for the first quarter of 2026 was NT$4.81 billion, with a gross margin of 13.23%. The revenue increased by 4.33 percentage points from the previous quarter and 4.84 percentage points from the same period last year. The company's net profit for the first quarter of 2026 was NT$16.04 million, a turnaround from a loss in the previous quarter and the same period last year. The net profit per share was NT$0.15.

Notably, Bao Rong's revenue for the second quarter of 2026 was NT$5.66 billion, a new high for the same period. The semiconductor application business accounted for 50.4% of the revenue, driving the company's gross margin and operating net profit margin to rise in the second quarter.

Under the circumstances of high demand for Bao Rong's semiconductor customers, the company has decided to further develop this business segment by purchasing a factory and land in the Taichung Industrial Zone for NT$323 million. This is also the largest commercial property purchase in the Taichung Industrial Zone this year, following the purchase by Great Wall (3008-TW). Bao Rong plans to invest in equipment and rebuild the factory to accommodate heavy pressing equipment and produce high-power heat sinks.

items.title: 三大記憶體廠2027年產能提前售罄 恐成史上最缺一年
items.title_en: Memory Shortage Expected to Hit Record Levels in 2027
paras: AI 浪潮持續推升記憶體需求，全球記憶體市場正迎來前所未有的結構性短缺週期。業界人士透露，三星電子 (005930KS) 、美光科技 (MU-US) 及 SK 海力士 (000660KS) 的 DRAM 與高頻寬記憶體（HBM）2027 年全年產能已提前完成分配，涵蓋長期供貨協議大客戶及部分中小型買家。
不僅 DRAM 供應提前被預訂，三星電子、美光及 SanDisk 的 NAND Flash 2027 年全年產能也已基本預售一空，鎧俠與 SK 海力士預計最晚於 2026 年 8 月底前完成產能分配。
市場人士指出，尚未提前鎖定產能的買家，2027 年恐面臨「無貨可買」的困境，而雲端服務供應商（CSP）及 AI 大廠的採購優先順序，也將持續壓縮手機、PC 等消費性電子產品的記憶體供應。
此次記憶體產能提前售罄，也印證 SK 集團此前對市場的警告，即 2027 年可能成為記憶體產業史上供需失衡最嚴重的一年。
SK 集團會長崔泰源指出，2027 年 AI 半導體需求預估將較 2026 年成長 60% 至 100%，整體儲存需求增幅可能達 50% 至 60%，供需缺口恐持續擴大。
AI 需求主導記憶體產能分配
此波記憶體供應緊張的核心驅動力，來自 AI 基礎建設快速擴張。各大記憶體原廠近期陸續與主要客戶簽署 3 至 5 年期長期供貨協議（LTA），使記憶體市場逐漸脫離過去傳統景氣循環模式，轉向由供應商掌握主導權的長期供應格局。
威剛 (3260-TW) 董事長陳立白表示，三星、美光及 SK 海力士三大記憶體原廠 2027 年產能早已售罄，其中 HBM 與 AI 伺服器相關應用將占 DRAM 產能約七成。在總產能有限的情況下，原廠優先滿足雲端服務商及 AI 企業需求，使手機與 PC 廠商可取得的 DRAM 配額受到壓縮。
業界估計，記憶體原廠實際可提供的產能，通常僅能滿足買方原始需求目標的六至七成，因此手機與 PC 廠商 2027 年取得的 DRAM 配額，預期將較 2026 年明顯減少。
NAND 供需仍存變數 企業級儲存需求支撐市場
相較於 DRAM 市場高度集中於三星、美光及 SK 海力士三大廠，NAND Flash 供應商數量較多，買方仍保有一定議價空間，因此市場對 2027 年 NAND 供需走向仍存在不同看法。
部分市場觀點認為，隨著新產能陸續釋出，加上消費性需求疲弱，2027 年下半年 NAND 市場供需可能逐步趨於寬鬆，價格壓力也可能升高。
不過，業界人士對此持保留態度，認為企業級固態硬碟（SSD）需求仍將維持強勁，企業級儲存需求可望支撐 NAND 市場，供應緊張情況可能延續至 2028 年，因此原廠擴產效果不宜過度樂觀。
記憶體採購模式轉變 提前鎖定產能成新常態
隨著記憶體供應持續吃緊，市場採購模式也出現結構性轉變。供應鏈人士透露，由於 2026 年產能供不應求情況延續，多家雲端服務商與品牌廠商開始提前爭搶未來產能，並配合原廠採取預付訂金模式完成交易。
目前產能分配範圍不僅涵蓋簽署長約的大型客戶，也包括部分已取得 2026 年供應額度、但原廠未必願意簽訂長約的中小型買家。各家記憶體廠將依內部協調結果，通知客戶可取得的產能額度。
業界人士指出，7 月至 8 月是記憶體產能分配的重要窗口期，但部分廠商並未掌握相關資訊，主要原因是市場參與者擔心消息公開後，將吸引更多買家加入競爭有限產能。
價格漲幅趨緩 高價環境恐成常態
儘管 2027 年記憶體供應仍將維持緊張，但價格走勢可能不會完全複製 2026 年的快速飆升。業界普遍認為，由於主要產能已提前完成分配，DRAM 與 NAND 最終價格仍需接近實際出貨時間才能確認，2027 年價格漲幅有望較 2026 年的大幅上漲趨於溫和。
不過，「價格高位常態化」恐成為記憶體市場的新常態。由於記憶體原廠掌握產能分配主導權，市場預期供應商仍將維持較強報價能力，整體供應緊張與終端成本壓力短期內難以明顯緩解。
對於尚未完成產能鎖定的廠商而言，未來可能面臨以更高價格採購，甚至供應不足的風險。2027 年記憶體市場競爭焦點，將不只是價格，而是能否取得足夠產能。
paras_en: The global memory market is facing a structural shortage, driven by the ongoing AI trend. Industry insiders revealed that Samsung (005930.KS), Micron (MU-US), and SK Hynix (000660.KS) have already allocated their 2027 annual production capacity for DRAM and high-bandwidth memory (HBM), covering long-term supply agreements with major customers and some smaller buyers.

Not only has DRAM supply been pre-booked, but Samsung, Micron, and SanDisk's NAND Flash 2027 annual production capacity has also been largely pre-sold out. SK Hynix and other manufacturers are expected to complete their production allocation by the end of August 2026 at the latest.

Market players warned that buyers who have not secured production capacity in advance may face a 'no stock to buy' situation in 2027. Cloud service providers (CSPs) and AI manufacturers will continue to prioritize their purchases, compressing memory supply for consumer electronics such as smartphones and PCs.
This memory production shortage also confirms SK Group's earlier warning that 2027 may be the most imbalanced year in memory industry history.

SK Group Chairman Lee Jae-yong predicted that AI semiconductor demand will grow by 60% to 100% in 2027 compared to 2026, while overall storage demand may increase by 50% to 60%, exacerbating the supply-demand gap.
AI demand drives memory production allocation

The core driver of this memory supply tension is the rapid expansion of AI infrastructure. Major memory manufacturers have recently signed 3- to 5-year long-term supply agreements (LTAs) with major customers, gradually shifting the memory market away from traditional cyclical patterns and towards a long-term supply structure controlled by suppliers.

Wei Guan (3260-TW) Chairman Chen Li-bai stated that the three major memory manufacturers, Samsung, Micron, and SK Hynix, have already sold out their 2027 production capacity, with HBM and AI server-related applications accounting for about 70% of DRAM production capacity. In a situation where overall production capacity is limited, manufacturers prioritize meeting the demands of cloud service providers and AI companies, compressing the DRAM allocations for smartphone and PC manufacturers.

Industry estimates suggest that memory manufacturers can only provide actual production capacity that meets 60% to 70% of buyers' original demand targets. As a result, smartphone and PC manufacturers are expected to receive significantly reduced DRAM allocations in 2027 compared to 2026.
NAND supply still uncertain Enterprise-level storage demand supports the market

In contrast to the highly concentrated DRAM market, which is dominated by Samsung, Micron, and SK Hynix, NAND Flash suppliers are more numerous, leaving buyers with some room for negotiation. Market views on NAND supply and demand in 2027 are therefore diverse.

Some market observers believe that with new production capacity being released and weak consumer demand, NAND market supply and demand may gradually ease in the second half of 2027, leading to higher prices.

However, industry insiders remain cautious, pointing out that enterprise-level solid-state drive (SSD) demand will remain strong, supporting the NAND market and potentially extending supply tension to 2028. Therefore, manufacturers' expansion efforts should not be overly optimistic.
Memory purchasing patterns shift to pre-booking capacity

As memory supply continues to tighten, market purchasing patterns have undergone a structural shift. Supply chain insiders revealed that due to the continued shortage of 2026 production capacity, many cloud service providers and brand manufacturers have begun to pre-book future capacity and cooperate with manufacturers to adopt prepayment models for transactions.

The allocation of production capacity now covers not only major customers who have signed long-term agreements but also some smaller buyers who have secured 2026 supply quotas but may not be willing to sign long-term agreements. Memory manufacturers will notify their customers of the available production capacity based on internal coordination results.

Industry insiders pointed out that July to August is a critical window period for memory production allocation, but some manufacturers do not have access to this information, mainly because market participants are concerned that publicizing the information will attract more buyers to compete for limited capacity.
Price increases may slow down High-price environment may become the norm

Although memory supply will remain tight in 2027, price trends may not follow the rapid escalation seen in 2026. Industry consensus is that since most production capacity has been pre-allocated, DRAM and NAND prices will only be confirmed near the actual shipping time, and 2027 price increases may be milder than those in 2026.

However, a high-price environment may become the new norm in the memory market. Since memory manufacturers control production allocation, market expectations are that suppliers will maintain strong pricing power, and overall supply tension and end-user cost pressure will be difficult to alleviate in the short term.

For manufacturers that have not completed production allocation, they may face the risk of purchasing at higher prices or even facing supply shortages in the future. In 2027, the focus of the memory market competition will not be on price, but on whether manufacturers can secure sufficient production capacity.

items.title: 8月領息潮一表看！00961、00891年化息率衝破17%搶當資金避風港
items.title_en: August Dividend Wave: 00961, 00891 Yearly Dividend Yield Breaks 17% to Become Safe Haven
paras: 台股近期受國際政經變數、AI 概念股震盪與資金輪動影響，大盤波動加劇，促使投資人轉向先領現金、降低波動的配置策略。隨著 8 月 ETF 除息旺季登場，月配、季配與半年配產品陸續公告配息，高股息、半導體與科技型 ETF 同步掀起領息熱潮，部分產品預估年化配息率甚至突破 10%，如月配息的 00961 及半年配的 00891 都高達 17%、成為震盪市況中的資金避風港。
月配息 ETF 競爭持續熾熱，8 月由 FT 台灣永續高息 (00961-TW) 拔得頭籌，每單位預估配息 0.19 元，年化息率高達 17.6%，且下半年以來總報酬維持 3.78%，展現兼具股息與績效的優勢。
台新 AI 優息動能 (00962-TW) 與中信成長高股息 (00934-TW) 則分別配發 0.16 元與 0.3 元，年化息率均超過 13%。此外，主動式 ETF 亦加入高配息戰局，主動摩根台灣鑫收 (00401A-TW) 與主動國泰動能高息 (00400A-TW) 年化息率突破 10%，惟下半年以來總報酬受盤勢修正影響呈現負值。

季配型 ETF 方面，半導體與高股息題材仍為市場目光焦點。中信關鍵半導體 (00891-TW) 本次配息 1.55 元，年化息率飆升至 18.4%；中信小資高價 30 (00894-TW) 配息 2.05 元，年化息率亦高達 18.1%，雙雙挺進高殖利率榜首。國民 ETF 國泰永續高股息 (00878-TW) 每單位配發 1.01 元，年化息率 12.4%，憑藉穩健配息紀錄與龐大受益人基礎，持續獲得存股族青睞。主動群益台灣強棒 (00982A-TW) 與主動野村台灣優選 (00980A-TW) 年化息率亦分別達 12.2% 與 11.5%，反映主動式策略積極搶進收益市場。
半年配產品則由科技與 ESG 題材領軍，國泰台灣科技龍頭 (00881-TW) 配息 4.6 元，年化息率高達 18.1%，為半年配表現最耀眼者；群益台 ESG 低碳 50 (00923-TW) 配發 3.05 元，年化息率達 15.1%。法人強調，ETF 配息來源包含成分股股利、資本利得及收益平準金，高息率不等於高總報酬，投資人在追逐高年化息率之餘，應審慎考量填息能力與整體淨值波動風險。

paras_en: Taiwan's stock market has been affected by international geopolitical factors, AI concept stocks, and capital rotation, leading to increased market volatility. As a result, investors are turning to strategies that prioritize receiving dividends and reducing volatility. With the arrival of August ETF dividend season, monthly, quarterly, and semi-annual products have announced their dividend payments, triggering a dividend frenzy among high-dividend, semiconductor, and technology ETFs. Some products are expected to have a yearly dividend yield of over 10%, such as the monthly dividend-paying 00961 and the semi-annual dividend-paying 00891, both with a yield of 17%, making them a safe haven in a volatile market.

The competition for monthly dividend ETFs remains intense, with FT Taiwan Sustainable High Dividend (00961-TW) taking the lead in August. Each unit is expected to receive a dividend of NT$0.19, with a yearly dividend yield of 17.6%. The product has maintained a total return of 3.78% since the second half of the year, demonstrating its strength in both dividend payments and performance.

Taiwan New AI High Dividend Dynamic (00962-TW) and China Development High Dividend (00934-TW) have announced dividend payments of NT$0.16 and NT$0.3, respectively, with both products exceeding a yearly dividend yield of 13%. Additionally, actively managed ETFs have entered the high-dividend fray, with Morgan Taiwan Xin Shou (00401A-TW) and China Development High Dividend (00400A-TW) both having a yearly dividend yield of over 10%. However, their total returns since the second half of the year have been negatively affected by market fluctuations.

In the quarterly ETF segment, semiconductor and high-dividend themes remain the focus of market attention. China Development Key Semiconductor (00891-TW) has announced a dividend payment of NT$1.55, with a yearly dividend yield of 18.4%. China Development Small Capital High Price 30 (00894-TW) has also announced a dividend payment of NT$2.05, with a yearly dividend yield of 18.1%, both products leading the high-yield list. China Development National ETF China Development Sustainable High Dividend (00878-TW) has announced a dividend payment of NT$1.01, with a yearly dividend yield of 12.4%. With its stable dividend payment record and large shareholder base, it continues to be favored by long-term investors. Actively managed products such as Yuanta Taiwan Strong Bat (00982A-TW) and Nomura Taiwan Optimal (00980A-TW) have also achieved yearly dividend yields of 12.2% and 11.5%, respectively, reflecting the active management strategy's aggressive pursuit of market returns.

In the semi-annual product segment, technology and ESG themes are leading the charge. China Development Taiwan Technology Leader (00881-TW) has announced a dividend payment of NT$4.6, with a yearly dividend yield of 18.1%, making it the most eye-catching product in the semi-annual segment. Yuanta Taiwan ESG Low Carbon 50 (00923-TW) has also announced a dividend payment of NT$3.05, with a yearly dividend yield of 15.1%. Experts emphasize that ETF dividend payments come from component stocks' dividends, capital gains, and income equalization funds, and high dividend yields do not necessarily translate to high total returns. Investors should carefully consider the dividend-paying ability and overall net asset value volatility when chasing high yearly dividend yields.

items.title: 〈力積電展望〉朱憲國重申「三個不變」 下半年每季營收估雙位數成長
items.title_en: Powerchip Sees Double-Digit Growth in H2, Reiterates 'Three Unchanged' Strategy
paras: 力積電(6770-TW)創辦人暨董事長黃崇仁驟逝，市場關注公司未來營運發展，總經理朱憲國今(4)日表示，儘管公司面臨重大人事變故，但本業向上、經營團隊及未來發展方向均沒有改變，並預期今年下半年營運持續升溫，第三、第四季營收均可望呈現雙位數季增。
朱憲國表示，力積電7月營收已完成結算，較6月小幅增加，隨著客戶需求與漲價效益逐步反映，8月起營運表現將進一步改善。依目前訂單與出貨狀況，今年各季營收將逐季成長，第三季較第二季，以及第四季較第三季，季增幅均可達雙位數。
近期全球股市大幅修正，市場也開始擔憂美國大型雲端服務供應商大舉投資AI基礎建設，可能出現投資過剩、資本回收不如預期等問題，加上韓國市場槓桿操作加劇波動，使投資人情緒轉趨恐慌。
不過，朱憲國指出，以實際接觸客戶與市場供需的情況來看，相關疑慮尚未反映在實體需求上。力積電目前仍持續調漲代工價格，市場供給吃緊及缺貨情況也沒有明顯改變，因此公司營運基本面與本業向上趨勢均未受到影響。
朱憲國強調，力積電目前有「三個不變」，第一是本業向上的趨勢沒有改變，儘管資本市場出現雜音，但實際客戶需求、代工價格及供需狀況仍維持正向，公司對下半年逐季成長的看法不變。
第二是經營團隊沒有改變。他表示，雖然黃崇仁突然離世，對公司而言是重大變故，但新任董事長謝再居與現有經營團隊合作已久，他本人與謝再居共同工作超過30年，公司許多重要幹部也已任職多年，團隊具有長期合作默契。
因此，黃崇仁離世並未造成經營團隊異動，公司各項營運均維持正常，客戶、訂單、生產及投資計畫也未受到實質影響。
第三則是未來發展方向不會改變。朱憲國指出，力積電將持續推動與AI、3D整合及先進封裝相關業務，相關業務占營收比重已由過去的3%、5%逐步提高至7%，公司設定未來三年內進一步提升至20%的目標。
朱憲國表示，力積電相關布局不只承接晶圓製造及先進封裝代工，也將延伸至重要元件與相關技術服務，藉此提高產品附加價值，擴大公司在AI及先進封裝供應鏈中的角色。
公司推動轉型的主要目的，是降低對傳統成熟製程代工的依賴，避開一般晶圓代工市場的紅海競爭，以及中國大陸同業持續擴產所帶來的價格壓力。
朱憲國指出，力積電同時具備邏輯與記憶體製造能力，也擁有國際合作及相關技術資產，未來透過晶圓製造、記憶體、AI應用與先進封裝業務的整合，相關綜效將逐步浮現。
paras_en: Powerchip (6770-TW) founder and chairman Huang Chong-jen's sudden passing has raised concerns about the company's future operations. However, CEO Chu Hsien-kuo reiterated that despite the significant personnel change, the company's business direction, management team, and future development strategy remain unchanged.
Chu expects the company's operations to continue to heat up in the second half of the year, with both the third and fourth quarters seeing double-digit growth in revenue.

Chu noted that Powerchip's July revenue has been finalized, showing a slight increase from June. As customer demand and pricing benefits continue to materialize, the company's operations are expected to improve further from August onwards.

Based on current order and shipment conditions, the company expects revenue to grow sequentially throughout the year, with the third quarter seeing double-digit growth over the second quarter and the fourth quarter seeing double-digit growth over the third quarter.

The recent global market correction has raised concerns about the potential for over-investment and capital returns in the AI infrastructure sector. Additionally, the Korean market's increased leverage has exacerbated volatility, leading to a panicked investor sentiment.

However, Chu pointed out that the concerns have not yet reflected in actual demand. Powerchip continues to raise its contract manufacturing prices, and the market supply and demand situation has not changed significantly, leaving the company's operations and business direction unaffected.

Chu emphasized that Powerchip currently has 'three unchanged' aspects: the first is the company's business direction, which remains unchanged despite market noise. The actual customer demand, contract manufacturing prices, and supply and demand situation continue to be positive, and the company's view on double-digit growth in the second half of the year remains unchanged.

The second is the management team, which has not changed. Chu noted that although Huang Chong-jen's sudden passing was a significant change, the new chairman, Hsieh Chien-ju, has worked with the existing management team for many years, and Chu himself has worked with Hsieh for over 30 years. Many key executives have also been with the company for a long time, and the team has a long history of cooperation.

The third is the company's future development direction, which will not change. Chu stated that Powerchip will continue to drive business related to AI, 3D integration, and advanced packaging. The related business has increased from 3% to 5% to 7% of revenue, and the company aims to reach 20% within the next three years.

Chu noted that Powerchip's layout is not only focused on wafer manufacturing and advanced packaging outsourcing but also extends to important components and related technical services, aiming to increase product value and expand the company's role in the AI and advanced packaging supply chain.

The company's transformation is primarily aimed at reducing dependence on traditional mature process outsourcing, avoiding the intense competition in the general wafer outsourcing market, and the price pressure brought about by the continuous expansion of Chinese mainland competitors.

Chu pointed out that Powerchip has both logic and memory manufacturing capabilities and possesses international cooperation and related technical assets. In the future, through the integration of wafer manufacturing, memory, AI applications, and advanced packaging businesses, the company expects to see synergies emerge.

items.title: 信邦7月營收連4個月改寫新高 今年無人機業務估倍數成長
items.title_en: XINBANG's July Revenue Sets New High for Four Consecutive Months; Drone Business Expected to Grow Multiple Times This Year
paras: 連接線大廠信邦(3023-TW)今(4)日公告7月營收31.67億元，連續4個月創公司成立以來單月營收歷史新高，月增2.41%、年增近29%；累計前7月營收205.54億元，創同期新高，年增11.44%。
針對市場關注的無人機布局，信邦表示，公司聚焦具高法規門檻與營運壁壘的「商用運輸」市場，避開競爭激烈的消費型空拍應用，隨著美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)正式核准相關營運與製造，該市場已由先前的驗證階段，逐步進入實際商業化營運。
信邦看好，今年無人機相關業務將較去年呈現倍數成長，在法規紅利與商用需求逐步釋放下，未來兩年將持續維持強勁的成長動能，成為公司下一波營運成長的新引擎。
針對7月營收表現，信邦說明，主要受惠於醫療、汽車及工業應用等領域銷售增溫，分別較6月增長14.80%、16.04%及4.05%。MAGIC 五大產業累計前7月表現相較去年同期，醫療及健康照護產業成長26.28%、汽車產業成長25.40%、綠能產業減少8.09%、工業應用產業成長30.51%、通訊及電子週邊產業減少9.41%。
營收比重方面，工業應用產業佔36.10%；通訊及電子週邊產業佔19.47%；綠能產業佔17.90%；汽車產業佔16.78%；醫療及健康照護產業佔9.75%；以產品別區分，連接線組生產銷售佔77.85%；連接器及零組件銷售佔22.15%。
paras_en: Cable manufacturer XINBANG (3023‑TW) announced today (4th) that July revenue reached NT$31.67 billion, marking the fourth consecutive month since the company's founding to hit a record‑high monthly revenue. The figure represents a month‑over‑month increase of 2.41% and a year‑over‑year rise of nearly 29%. Cumulative revenue for the first seven months of the year totaled NT$205.54 billion, also a new peak for the same period, up 11.44% year‑on‑year.

Regarding market interest in its drone initiatives, XINBANG said it is focusing on the "commercial transport" segment, which has high regulatory thresholds and operational barriers, and deliberately avoiding the fiercely competitive consumer‑drone market. With the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) now formally approving related operations and manufacturing, the market has moved from a validation stage to gradual commercial deployment.

XINBANG is optimistic that its drone‑related business will grow multiple times compared with last year. Benefiting from regulatory incentives and the gradual release of commercial demand, the company expects strong growth momentum to continue over the next two years, positioning drones as the next engine for operational expansion.

On the July revenue performance, XINBANG explained that the increase was mainly driven by higher sales in medical, automotive and industrial applications, which rose 14.80%, 16.04% and 4.05% respectively versus June. Across its five core segments, year‑to‑date performance versus the same period last year showed medical and health‑care up 26.28%, automotive up 25.40%, green energy down 8.09%, industrial applications up 30.51% and communications/electronics peripherals down 9.41%.

In terms of revenue composition, industrial applications accounted for 36.10%; communications and electronics peripherals 19.47%; green energy 17.90%; automotive 16.78%; and medical and health‑care 9.75%. By product type, cable assemblies contributed 77.85% of sales, while connectors and components made up the remaining 22.15%.

items.title: 高端腸病毒疫苗首批出口至越南 8月起貢獻營收
items.title_en: High-End Vaccine's First Batch Exported to Vietnam, to Contribute to Revenue Starting August
paras: 高端疫苗(6547-TW)今年上半年取得越南藥品管理局(DAV)核發的新藥上市許可後，目前完成品質檢驗並進行批次放行程序，於今(4)日啟動首批疫苗出口作業，運抵越南，預計8月開始貢獻營收，後續將運送各批次疫苗，今年將持續出貨。
高端疫苗旗下自主研發「恩穩健」腸病毒71型疫苗，於今年3月17日取得越南法規主管機關核准核發的新藥上市許可證，為越南官方核發的首張腸病毒疫苗藥證。
高端疫苗指出，為確保疫苗在跨國運輸過程中，完全符合國際優良運銷規範(GDP)要求，公司選用「主動式溫控集裝箱」，透過精密的數位控溫與獨立供電系統，有效排除長途空運與外在氣候的潛在變數，讓每劑疫苗自台灣廠區至飛抵越南的過程中，皆受到恆溫防護，維持與出廠時一致的品質。
paras_en: High-end vaccine (6547-TW) obtained a new drug license from Vietnam's Drug Administration of Vietnam (DAV) in the first half of this year. After completing quality inspections and batch release procedures, the company initiated its first vaccine export operation today (4th), shipping the vaccines to Vietnam. It is expected to start contributing to revenue in August, with subsequent batches to be shipped continuously throughout the year.

High-end vaccine's self-developed 'EV71 vaccine' obtained a new drug license from Vietnam's regulatory authority on March 17th this year, marking the first enterovirus vaccine license issued by the Vietnamese government.

To ensure the vaccines meet international good distribution practice (GDP) requirements during cross-border transportation, the company uses 'active temperature-controlled containers' with precise digital temperature control and independent power supply systems. This effectively eliminates potential variables from long-distance air transport and external climate, keeping each dose of vaccine at a consistent temperature from the factory in Taiwan to arrival in Vietnam, maintaining the same quality as when it left the factory.

items.title: 百容半導體應用業務需求強 7月營收優於上月創50個月來新高
items.title_en: Bao Rong Semiconductor Sees Strong Demand for Its Application Business, 7M Revenue Surpasses 50-Month High
paras: 百容 (2483-TW)今(4)日公布最新營收資訊， 在半導體客戶端下單且拉貨趨積極之下，推升 7 月營收向上，百容 7 月營收勝 6 月的 1.98 億元達2.01億元，改寫 50 個月 來單月營收新高。
百容2026年 7 月營收2.01億元，月增1.75%，年增37.19%，2026年1-7月營收12.47億元，年增幅達20.24%，百容 7月的營收比重中，半導體應用客戶拉貨力道仍強勁，另因反映銅價上漲， 提升此一業務區塊的營收向上。
百容 2026 年第二季單季營收達 5.66 億元，創同期新高，季增 17.62%，年增 20.42%，同時，在百容第二季在毛利率及營業利益同步走高，加上業外及匯率等有利因素挹注，百容所獲挹注上半年稅後純益將逾 4362 萬元，每股純益達 0.41 元。百容將在 8 月 7 日公布財報獲利數字。
百容在 2026 年第一季財報營收 4.81 億元，毛利率 13.23%，季增 4.33 個百分點，年增 4.84 個百分點，2026 年第一季稅後純益 1604 萬元，較上一季及去年同期都由虧轉盈，每股純益 0.15 元。在第二季自結數字之下，顯示百容在 2026 年第二季維持盈餘的營運，且單季本業、業外獲利表現甚佳之下，單季營收及獲利更進一步超越第一季表現。
值得注意的是，百容在 2026 年第二季營收達 5.66 億元，創同期新高，其中半導體應用占比也達 50.4%，並帶動第二季單季的毛利率及營業淨利率上揚的走勢。
在百容半導體客戶需求高持續追單有利情況之下，公司爲進一步發展此一業務區塊，董事會決議以 3.23 億元購置台中工業區工一路廠房及土地，這也是今年以來繼大立光 (3008-TW) 在台中工業區的提供生產用商用不動產購置案。 百容購置台中工業區工一路廠房及土地，土地面積達 702 坪，預計將另投入資金購買設備及另重新與建廠房容納重型沖壓設備進駐，將開發生產大功率散熱片。
paras_en: Bao Rong (2483-TW) announced its latest revenue information today, with the company's semiconductor client orders and shipments becoming more active, driving 7M revenue up. Bao Rong's 7M revenue of NT$2.01 billion surpassed NT$1.98 billion in June, setting a new high for the company's single-month revenue over the past 50 months.

Bao Rong's 7M revenue was NT$2.01 billion, up 1.75% from the previous month and 37.19% from the same period last year. The company's revenue for the first seven months of 2026 was NT$12.47 billion, with a year-over-year growth rate of 20.24%. In 7M, the revenue of Bao Rong's semiconductor application business remained strong, and the revenue increase was also driven by the rise in copper prices.

Bao Rong's revenue for the second quarter of 2026 was NT$5.66 billion, a new high for the same period. The revenue increased by 17.62% from the previous quarter and 20.42% from the same period last year. At the same time, Bao Rong's gross margin and operating profit both rose in the second quarter, and the company also benefited from favorable factors such as industry and exchange rates. As a result, Bao Rong's net profit for the first half of 2026 is expected to exceed NT$43.62 million, with a net profit per share of NT$0.41.

Bao Rong's revenue for the first quarter of 2026 was NT$4.81 billion, with a gross margin of 13.23%. The revenue increased by 4.33 percentage points from the previous quarter and 4.84 percentage points from the same period last year. The company's net profit for the first quarter of 2026 was NT$16.04 million, a turnaround from a loss in the previous quarter and the same period last year. The net profit per share was NT$0.15.

Notably, Bao Rong's revenue for the second quarter of 2026 was NT$5.66 billion, a new high for the same period. The semiconductor application business accounted for 50.4% of the revenue, driving the company's gross margin and operating net profit margin to rise in the second quarter.

Under the circumstances of high demand for Bao Rong's semiconductor customers, the company has decided to further develop this business segment by purchasing a factory and land in the Taichung Industrial Zone for NT$323 million. This is also the largest commercial property purchase in the Taichung Industrial Zone this year, following the purchase by Great Wall (3008-TW). Bao Rong plans to invest in equipment and rebuild the factory to accommodate heavy pressing equipment and produce high-power heat sinks.

items.title: 8月領息潮一表看！00961、00891年化息率衝破17%搶當資金避風港
items.title_en: August Dividend Wave: 00961, 00891 Yearly Dividend Yield Breaks 17% to Become Safe Haven
paras: 台股近期受國際政經變數、AI 概念股震盪與資金輪動影響，大盤波動加劇，促使投資人轉向先領現金、降低波動的配置策略。隨著 8 月 ETF 除息旺季登場，月配、季配與半年配產品陸續公告配息，高股息、半導體與科技型 ETF 同步掀起領息熱潮，部分產品預估年化配息率甚至突破 10%，如月配息的 00961 及半年配的 00891 都高達 17%、成為震盪市況中的資金避風港。
月配息 ETF 競爭持續熾熱，8 月由 FT 台灣永續高息 (00961-TW) 拔得頭籌，每單位預估配息 0.19 元，年化息率高達 17.6%，且下半年以來總報酬維持 3.78%，展現兼具股息與績效的優勢。
台新 AI 優息動能 (00962-TW) 與中信成長高股息 (00934-TW) 則分別配發 0.16 元與 0.3 元，年化息率均超過 13%。此外，主動式 ETF 亦加入高配息戰局，主動摩根台灣鑫收 (00401A-TW) 與主動國泰動能高息 (00400A-TW) 年化息率突破 10%，惟下半年以來總報酬受盤勢修正影響呈現負值。

季配型 ETF 方面，半導體與高股息題材仍為市場目光焦點。中信關鍵半導體 (00891-TW) 本次配息 1.55 元，年化息率飆升至 18.4%；中信小資高價 30 (00894-TW) 配息 2.05 元，年化息率亦高達 18.1%，雙雙挺進高殖利率榜首。國民 ETF 國泰永續高股息 (00878-TW) 每單位配發 1.01 元，年化息率 12.4%，憑藉穩健配息紀錄與龐大受益人基礎，持續獲得存股族青睞。主動群益台灣強棒 (00982A-TW) 與主動野村台灣優選 (00980A-TW) 年化息率亦分別達 12.2% 與 11.5%，反映主動式策略積極搶進收益市場。
半年配產品則由科技與 ESG 題材領軍，國泰台灣科技龍頭 (00881-TW) 配息 4.6 元，年化息率高達 18.1%，為半年配表現最耀眼者；群益台 ESG 低碳 50 (00923-TW) 配發 3.05 元，年化息率達 15.1%。法人強調，ETF 配息來源包含成分股股利、資本利得及收益平準金，高息率不等於高總報酬，投資人在追逐高年化息率之餘，應審慎考量填息能力與整體淨值波動風險。

paras_en: Taiwan's stock market has been affected by international geopolitical factors, AI concept stocks, and capital rotation, leading to increased market volatility. As a result, investors are turning to strategies that prioritize receiving dividends and reducing volatility. With the arrival of August ETF dividend season, monthly, quarterly, and semi-annual products have announced their dividend payments, triggering a dividend frenzy among high-dividend, semiconductor, and technology ETFs. Some products are expected to have a yearly dividend yield of over 10%, such as the monthly dividend-paying 00961 and the semi-annual dividend-paying 00891, both with a yield of 17%, making them a safe haven in a volatile market.

The competition for monthly dividend ETFs remains intense, with FT Taiwan Sustainable High Dividend (00961-TW) taking the lead in August. Each unit is expected to receive a dividend of NT$0.19, with a yearly dividend yield of 17.6%. The product has maintained a total return of 3.78% since the second half of the year, demonstrating its strength in both dividend payments and performance.

Taiwan New AI High Dividend Dynamic (00962-TW) and China Development High Dividend (00934-TW) have announced dividend payments of NT$0.16 and NT$0.3, respectively, with both products exceeding a yearly dividend yield of 13%. Additionally, actively managed ETFs have entered the high-dividend fray, with Morgan Taiwan Xin Shou (00401A-TW) and China Development High Dividend (00400A-TW) both having a yearly dividend yield of over 10%. However, their total returns since the second half of the year have been negatively affected by market fluctuations.

In the quarterly ETF segment, semiconductor and high-dividend themes remain the focus of market attention. China Development Key Semiconductor (00891-TW) has announced a dividend payment of NT$1.55, with a yearly dividend yield of 18.4%. China Development Small Capital High Price 30 (00894-TW) has also announced a dividend payment of NT$2.05, with a yearly dividend yield of 18.1%, both products leading the high-yield list. China Development National ETF China Development Sustainable High Dividend (00878-TW) has announced a dividend payment of NT$1.01, with a yearly dividend yield of 12.4%. With its stable dividend payment record and large shareholder base, it continues to be favored by long-term investors. Actively managed products such as Yuanta Taiwan Strong Bat (00982A-TW) and Nomura Taiwan Optimal (00980A-TW) have also achieved yearly dividend yields of 12.2% and 11.5%, respectively, reflecting the active management strategy's aggressive pursuit of market returns.

In the semi-annual product segment, technology and ESG themes are leading the charge. China Development Taiwan Technology Leader (00881-TW) has announced a dividend payment of NT$4.6, with a yearly dividend yield of 18.1%, making it the most eye-catching product in the semi-annual segment. Yuanta Taiwan ESG Low Carbon 50 (00923-TW) has also announced a dividend payment of NT$3.05, with a yearly dividend yield of 15.1%. Experts emphasize that ETF dividend payments come from component stocks' dividends, capital gains, and income equalization funds, and high dividend yields do not necessarily translate to high total returns. Investors should carefully consider the dividend-paying ability and overall net asset value volatility when chasing high yearly dividend yields.

items.title: 〈力積電展望〉朱憲國重申「三個不變」 下半年每季營收估雙位數成長
items.title_en: Powerchip Sees Double-Digit Growth in H2, Reiterates 'Three Unchanged' Strategy
paras: 力積電(6770-TW)創辦人暨董事長黃崇仁驟逝，市場關注公司未來營運發展，總經理朱憲國今(4)日表示，儘管公司面臨重大人事變故，但本業向上、經營團隊及未來發展方向均沒有改變，並預期今年下半年營運持續升溫，第三、第四季營收均可望呈現雙位數季增。
朱憲國表示，力積電7月營收已完成結算，較6月小幅增加，隨著客戶需求與漲價效益逐步反映，8月起營運表現將進一步改善。依目前訂單與出貨狀況，今年各季營收將逐季成長，第三季較第二季，以及第四季較第三季，季增幅均可達雙位數。
近期全球股市大幅修正，市場也開始擔憂美國大型雲端服務供應商大舉投資AI基礎建設，可能出現投資過剩、資本回收不如預期等問題，加上韓國市場槓桿操作加劇波動，使投資人情緒轉趨恐慌。
不過，朱憲國指出，以實際接觸客戶與市場供需的情況來看，相關疑慮尚未反映在實體需求上。力積電目前仍持續調漲代工價格，市場供給吃緊及缺貨情況也沒有明顯改變，因此公司營運基本面與本業向上趨勢均未受到影響。
朱憲國強調，力積電目前有「三個不變」，第一是本業向上的趨勢沒有改變，儘管資本市場出現雜音，但實際客戶需求、代工價格及供需狀況仍維持正向，公司對下半年逐季成長的看法不變。
第二是經營團隊沒有改變。他表示，雖然黃崇仁突然離世，對公司而言是重大變故，但新任董事長謝再居與現有經營團隊合作已久，他本人與謝再居共同工作超過30年，公司許多重要幹部也已任職多年，團隊具有長期合作默契。
因此，黃崇仁離世並未造成經營團隊異動，公司各項營運均維持正常，客戶、訂單、生產及投資計畫也未受到實質影響。
第三則是未來發展方向不會改變。朱憲國指出，力積電將持續推動與AI、3D整合及先進封裝相關業務，相關業務占營收比重已由過去的3%、5%逐步提高至7%，公司設定未來三年內進一步提升至20%的目標。
朱憲國表示，力積電相關布局不只承接晶圓製造及先進封裝代工，也將延伸至重要元件與相關技術服務，藉此提高產品附加價值，擴大公司在AI及先進封裝供應鏈中的角色。
公司推動轉型的主要目的，是降低對傳統成熟製程代工的依賴，避開一般晶圓代工市場的紅海競爭，以及中國大陸同業持續擴產所帶來的價格壓力。
朱憲國指出，力積電同時具備邏輯與記憶體製造能力，也擁有國際合作及相關技術資產，未來透過晶圓製造、記憶體、AI應用與先進封裝業務的整合，相關綜效將逐步浮現。
paras_en: Powerchip (6770-TW) founder and chairman Huang Chong-jen's sudden passing has raised concerns about the company's future operations. However, CEO Chu Hsien-kuo reiterated that despite the significant personnel change, the company's business direction, management team, and future development strategy remain unchanged.
Chu expects the company's operations to continue to heat up in the second half of the year, with both the third and fourth quarters seeing double-digit growth in revenue.

Chu noted that Powerchip's July revenue has been finalized, showing a slight increase from June. As customer demand and pricing benefits continue to materialize, the company's operations are expected to improve further from August onwards.

Based on current order and shipment conditions, the company expects revenue to grow sequentially throughout the year, with the third quarter seeing double-digit growth over the second quarter and the fourth quarter seeing double-digit growth over the third quarter.

The recent global market correction has raised concerns about the potential for over-investment and capital returns in the AI infrastructure sector. Additionally, the Korean market's increased leverage has exacerbated volatility, leading to a panicked investor sentiment.

However, Chu pointed out that the concerns have not yet reflected in actual demand. Powerchip continues to raise its contract manufacturing prices, and the market supply and demand situation has not changed significantly, leaving the company's operations and business direction unaffected.

Chu emphasized that Powerchip currently has 'three unchanged' aspects: the first is the company's business direction, which remains unchanged despite market noise. The actual customer demand, contract manufacturing prices, and supply and demand situation continue to be positive, and the company's view on double-digit growth in the second half of the year remains unchanged.

The second is the management team, which has not changed. Chu noted that although Huang Chong-jen's sudden passing was a significant change, the new chairman, Hsieh Chien-ju, has worked with the existing management team for many years, and Chu himself has worked with Hsieh for over 30 years. Many key executives have also been with the company for a long time, and the team has a long history of cooperation.

The third is the company's future development direction, which will not change. Chu stated that Powerchip will continue to drive business related to AI, 3D integration, and advanced packaging. The related business has increased from 3% to 5% to 7% of revenue, and the company aims to reach 20% within the next three years.

Chu noted that Powerchip's layout is not only focused on wafer manufacturing and advanced packaging outsourcing but also extends to important components and related technical services, aiming to increase product value and expand the company's role in the AI and advanced packaging supply chain.

The company's transformation is primarily aimed at reducing dependence on traditional mature process outsourcing, avoiding the intense competition in the general wafer outsourcing market, and the price pressure brought about by the continuous expansion of Chinese mainland competitors.

Chu pointed out that Powerchip has both logic and memory manufacturing capabilities and possesses international cooperation and related technical assets. In the future, through the integration of wafer manufacturing, memory, AI applications, and advanced packaging businesses, the company expects to see synergies emerge.

items.title: 〈力積電展望〉謝再居臨危接棒 自認與黃崇仁個性互補「風格較保守」
items.title_en: Powerchip Technology Outlook: Xie Zaiju Takes the Helm in Crisis, Claims Complementary Personality with Founder Huang Chong‑jen "More Conservative Style"
paras: 力積電 (6770-TW) 今(4)日舉辦記者會，創辦人暨董事長黃崇仁驟逝，代理董事長謝再居首度公開發言。他坦言，黃崇仁離世來得突然，自己原先已逐步淡出第一線營運，如今有點像「鴨子上架」，但經過思慮後仍決定承擔穩定公司大局的責任，並強調現有經營團隊仍維持穩定，並補充「自己的風格較為保守」，與創辦人黃崇仁互補。
謝再居表示，黃崇仁上週突然離世，對公司上下而言是極為震驚的消息。當時他人在美國洽談合作，於當地半夜得知噩耗，直到週日早上才從達拉斯趕回台灣。返台後數日，他除與公司經營管理團隊密集討論，也持續與黃崇仁家屬及親友溝通，希望盡快確認公司後續安排。
謝再居坦言，近年來隨著年齡增長，自己與黃崇仁的體力、腦力均不如以往，因此他早在兩年前便辭去總經理職務，原本希望逐步退休、淡出第一線營運。未料公司突然面臨接班變局，經營團隊仍希望他重新出面主持大局，因此決定承擔董事長職務。
相較於黃崇仁長期以來樂觀、外向，且樂於與媒體交流，謝再居自認個性較為低調，過去主要專注於公司實際營運，較少公開面對媒體，而此次接任董事長是「鴨子上架」，如今正式站上第一線，所肩負的責任與壓力更為重大。
謝再居指出，他原本認為，卸任總經理後轉任副董事長，只是公司為他安排的一個「退休台階」，讓他逐步退居幕後，沒想到這個台階如今反而成為重新承擔責任的踏腳石，迫使他再度回到公司決策核心。
不過，他強調，黃崇仁家屬未來仍會延續黃崇仁的態度，持續支持力積電經營團隊，讓公司在既有基礎上繼續發展，因此目前公司經營團隊相當穩固，不會因董事長異動而出現重大變化。
談及未來經營風格，謝再居直言，黃崇仁一向非常樂觀、開放，只要看到新的市場機會，就會積極投入，優先思考這項機會能為公司帶來哪些好處；相較之下，他的個性較為謹慎，面對新機會時，首先考量的是風險在哪裡，以及公司是否具備承擔能力。
他表示，過去兩人的個性具有互補作用，黃崇仁積極向前衝，他則適時提醒、控制風險，避免公司前進過快。如今最終決策責任落在自己身上，因此可以預見，力積電未來的經營風格將比過去更加保守，不會採取過度積極或冒進的策略。
謝再居也向股東及投資人喊話，儘管黃崇仁離世讓公司上下深感不捨，但力積電既有團隊、營運架構及發展方向均未改變，公司將在穩健控管風險的前提下持續前進，希望廣大股東能夠放心。
paras_en: Powerchip Technology (6770‑TW) held a press conference today (the 4th). Founder and chairman Huang Chong‑jen passed away suddenly, and acting chairman Xie Zaiju spoke publicly for the first time. He admitted that Huang’s death was abrupt; he had already been gradually stepping back from frontline operations, and now feels like a "duck on a perch," but after deliberation he decided to assume responsibility for stabilizing the company’s overall situation, emphasizing that the existing management team remains stable and adding that "my style is more conservative," complementing founder Huang’s approach.

Xie Zaiju said Huang Chong‑jen’s sudden death last week was shocking news for the whole company. At the time, Xie was in the United States negotiating a partnership and learned of the tragedy in the middle of the night there, returning from Dallas to Taiwan early Sunday morning. In the days after his return, he held intensive discussions with the company’s management team and kept communicating with Huang’s family and friends, aiming to quickly confirm the company’s subsequent arrangements.

Xie confessed that as he and Huang have aged, both their physical and mental stamina have declined, so he resigned as general manager two years ago, originally hoping to retire gradually and step away from frontline operations. He did not anticipate the sudden succession crisis; the management team still wanted him to step back into a leading role, so he decided to take on the chairman position.

Compared with Huang’s long‑standing optimism, extroversion, and willingness to engage with the media, Xie sees himself as more low‑key, having focused mainly on day‑to‑day operations and rarely appearing publicly. This takeover is a "duck on a perch"—now he is officially on the front line, bearing greater responsibility and pressure.

Xie noted that he originally thought moving from general manager to vice‑chairman after stepping down was merely a "retirement step" arranged by the company to let him fade into the background, but that step has unexpectedly become a platform for him to resume core decision‑making responsibilities.

He stressed that Huang’s family will continue to uphold his attitude and keep supporting Powerchip’s management team, allowing the company to develop on its existing foundation. Thus, the current management team remains solid and will not undergo major changes due to the chairman transition.

Discussing future management style, Xie said Huang was always very optimistic and open; whenever he saw a new market opportunity, he would eagerly pursue it, first considering the benefits for the company. In contrast, Xie is more cautious, first assessing the risks and whether the company can bear them when faced with new opportunities.

He explained that the two personalities have historically complemented each other—Huang would push forward aggressively while Xie would timely remind and control risks to prevent the company from moving too fast. Now that final decision‑making rests with him, he foresees Powerchip’s future operating style becoming more conservative than before, avoiding overly aggressive or reckless strategies.

Xie also addressed shareholders and investors, acknowledging the deep sorrow caused by Huang’s passing but affirming that Powerchip’s team, operational structure, and development direction remain unchanged. The company will continue to move forward under prudent risk management, and he hopes shareholders can feel confident.

items.title: 〈力積電展望〉謝再居喊話近70萬股東 承諾未來年年獲利、恢復配息
items.title_en: Powerchip Semiconductor Outlook: Chairman Hsieh Tsai-ju Calls on Nearly 700,000 Shareholders, Promises Annual Profits and Restored Dividends
paras: 力積電(6770-TW)代理董事長謝再居今(4)日首度對外說明公司未來營運方向，他向廣大股東喊話，隨著記憶體、邏輯代工及AI相關業務三大支柱逐步成形，加上出售銅鑼廠予美光後，財務結構明顯改善，若未來市場維持基本動能，力積電不只今年，明、後年也可望持續獲利，並承諾朝「年年獲利、年年配息」目標邁進。
謝再居表示，力積電目前主要營運基礎包括三大代工業務，第一是公司最早發展的記憶體代工，涵蓋DRAM與Flash；第二是約十多年前切入的邏輯晶圓代工；第三則是近年逐漸成形、與AI及先進封裝相關的半導體零組件與製程服務。
其中，AI相關業務將成為力積電未來相當重要的新成長動能，目前推進成果也相當不錯。公司將持續依照既定方向，擴大相關技術與產能布局，強化在AI、高頻寬記憶體及先進封裝供應鏈中的角色。
謝再居指出，公司今年最大調整，是將銅鑼廠出售予美光，預計可帶來逾新台幣500億元現金流入，有助力積電降低負債比、改善財務結構，並減輕低產能利用率所帶來的折舊與固定成本壓力。
他說明，銅鑼廠原先以邏輯代工為主要發展方向，但實際營運未能如預期逐步提升，產能利用率長期偏低，不僅累積大量相關費用，也未創造足夠營收，因此公司決定透過交易重新調整資源配置。
不過，此項交易並非單純出售資產，也進一步開啟力積電與美光之間的新合作機會。謝再居強調，雙方未來合作將聚焦兩大方向，首先是PWF晶圓後段製程代工，包含HBM記憶體堆疊相關製造服務；其次則是透過美光協助，推進相關製程技術，提升力積電支援重要代工客戶的能力。
謝再居認為，力積電若能順利切入HBM後段製程及堆疊相關代工，不僅可擴大既有代工服務範圍，也有望成為公司下一階段的重要成長來源。
在營運展望方面，謝再居表示，未來幾年整體市場環境對半導體產業相對有利，力積電自今年初以來營收持續成長，且市場熱度與代工平均售價上揚，後續將陸續反映在公司營收與獲利表現。
他指出，晶圓代工業者的價格通常在客戶投片時確定，從投片到產品完成，短則約兩個月，長則可能需要四個月，因此市場需求升溫與平均售價提升，不會立刻反映在當期營收，而是存在一定遞延效果。因此，力積電未來半年營運可望逐步走高，全年營收高點預計落在年底，預期今年營收表現將相當不錯，獲利也可望明顯改善。
隨著獲利回升，力積電配息也有望恢復。謝再居表示，依公司規章，只要公司有獲利，每半年將進行一次配息，預計下個月董事會可能討論並決定上半年配息。
他也特別感謝股東多年來的耐心與支持。謝再居表示，只要市場維持目前基本狀況，力積電不只今年，明年及後年也有望持續獲利。
謝再居進一步承諾，黃崇仁今年曾要求他在股東會上宣示，未來力積電要恢復配發股利，希望自明年起真正落實，並在本屆任期內朝年年獲利、年年配息的方向前進。
他最後向力積電近70萬名股東喊話，公司營運基礎、事業布局及未來方向均已逐步確立，隨著財務結構改善、新業務開展及半導體景氣回溫，力積電將力拚重返穩定獲利軌道，希望股東能對公司未來發展保持信心。
根據集保中心最新資料顯示，截止至7月底前，力積電股東人數高達69.2萬名，當中有25%的股權集中在10張以下的持股。
paras_en: Powerchip Semiconductor (6770-TW) acting chairman Hsieh Tsai-ju explained the company’s future operating direction for the first time today (April 4). He addressed shareholders, saying that as the three pillars—memory, logic foundry and AI‑related businesses—gradually take shape, and after the sale of the Tongluo fab to Micron, the financial structure has markedly improved. If market momentum remains, Powerchip can not only be profitable this year but also in the next two years, and he pledged to pursue a "profit every year, dividend every year" goal.

Hsieh said Powerchip’s current operating foundation consists of three main foundry businesses: the earliest memory foundry covering DRAM and Flash; the logic wafer foundry entered about a decade ago; and the newer semiconductor components and process services tied to AI and advanced packaging that have been forming in recent years.

The AI‑related business will become a very important new growth engine for Powerchip, and its progress so far is encouraging. The company will continue to expand related technology and capacity according to its set direction, strengthening its role in the AI, high‑bandwidth memory and advanced‑packaging supply chains.

Hsieh noted the biggest adjustment this year is the sale of the Tongluo fab to Micron, expected to bring in more than NT$50 billion in cash. This will help Powerchip lower its debt ratio, improve its financial structure, and ease depreciation and fixed‑cost pressure caused by low capacity utilization.

He explained that the Tongluo fab was originally focused on logic foundry, but its operations failed to improve as expected, with persistently low capacity utilization. This led to large accumulated costs without sufficient revenue, prompting the company to re‑allocate resources through the transaction.

However, the deal is not merely an asset sale; it also opens new cooperation opportunities between Powerchip and Micron. Hsieh emphasized that future collaboration will focus on two areas: first, PWF wafer back‑end processing foundry, including HBM memory stacking services; second, leveraging Micron’s assistance to advance related process technologies and enhance Powerchip’s ability to support key foundry customers.

Hsieh believes that if Powerchip can successfully enter HBM back‑end processing and stacking foundry, it will not only broaden its existing foundry service scope but also become a major source of growth for the next stage of the company.

Regarding operational outlook, Hsieh said the overall market environment will remain relatively favorable for the semiconductor industry in the coming years. Since the beginning of this year, Powerchip’s revenue has been continuously growing, and market enthusiasm and average foundry pricing are rising, which will later be reflected in the company’s revenue and profit performance.

He pointed out that wafer foundry pricing is usually set when customers ship wafers. From shipment to product completion takes anywhere from about two months to up to four months. Therefore, rising demand and higher average prices will not immediately show up in current‑period revenue but will have a lag effect. Consequently, Powerchip’s operations over the next six months are expected to gradually improve, with the revenue peak projected toward year‑end. This year’s revenue is expected to be quite strong, and profits should improve markedly.

With profit recovery, dividend distribution is also expected to resume. Hsieh said that under company regulations, as long as the company is profitable, a dividend is paid semi‑annually. The board may discuss and decide the first‑half dividend at next month’s meeting.

He also expressed special thanks for shareholders’ patience and support over the years. Hsieh reiterated that as long as the market maintains its current basic conditions, Powerchip can not only be profitable this year but also in the next two years.

Hsieh further pledged that Huang Chong‑jen asked him at this year’s shareholders’ meeting to declare that Powerchip will restore dividend payouts in the future, hoping to implement it starting next year and to move toward annual profit and dividend during his current term.

He concluded by addressing Powerchip’s nearly 700,000 shareholders, stating that the company’s operating foundation, business layout and future direction have been progressively established. With an improved financial structure, new business development and a warming semiconductor cycle, Powerchip will strive to return to a stable profit track and hopes shareholders will stay confident in the company’s future development.

According to the latest data from the Central Depository & Clearing House, as of the end of July, Powerchip’s shareholder count reached 692,000, with 25% of the shares concentrated in holders of fewer than ten lots.

paras: 台股今 (4) 日持續震盪，早盤一度跌近 500 點，失守 4 萬 3，盤中翻紅最高漲至 43912.77 點，高低震盪逾千點，不過隨後再度翻黑，終場跌 25.75 點或 0.06%，雖守住 4 萬 3，但未能收復月線，成交量則重回兆元，達 1.04 兆元；三大法人合計買超 1.09 億元。

paras_en: The Taiwan stock market fluctuated today (4th), with the index once falling nearly 500 points in the morning session, breaking below 43,000.
